name: PIPEDA (Canada)
law: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA), S.C. 2000, c. 5

deadline.text: Within 30 calendar days of receiving the request. The organization may extend this by up to a further 30 days in limited cases (for example, unreasonable interference with its activities, or necessary consultations), but it must tell you within the first 30 days and inform you of your right to complain to the Privacy Commissioner. Access should be free or at minimal cost.
deadline.citation: PIPEDA s. 8(3)-(4); OPC guidance on responding to access requests

CA.name: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC)

cite.en: Principle 4.9 (Individual Access) in Schedule 1 of PIPEDA
cite.fr: Principe 4.9 (Accès aux renseignements personnels) de l'annexe 1 de la LPRPDE

text.en: Please inform me of the existence, use and disclosure of my personal information and give me access to it, including any third parties to which it has been disclosed. I expect a response within 30 days of this request.
text.fr: Veuillez m'informer de l'existence de renseignements personnels qui me concernent, de l'usage qui en est fait et du fait qu'ils ont été communiqués à des tiers, et m'en donner accès. Je vous saurais gré de me répondre dans un délai de 30 jours suivant la réception de cette demande.

cite.en: Principle 4.9.5 (Individual Access) in Schedule 1 of PIPEDA
cite.fr: Principe 4.9.5 (Accès aux renseignements personnels) de l'annexe 1 de la LPRPDE

text.en: Please amend the inaccurate or incomplete personal information you hold about me, as specified in this request, and confirm in writing once done. Where appropriate, please pass the amended information to third parties that have access to it.
text.fr: Veuillez modifier ou corriger les renseignements personnels inexacts ou incomplets me concernant, tel que précisé dans la présente demande, et m'en donner confirmation écrite. Le cas échéant, veuillez transmettre ces modifications aux tiers ayant accès à ces renseignements.

cite.fr: Principe 4.3.8 (Consentement) de l'annexe 1 de la LPRPDE

text.en: I hereby withdraw my consent to the collection, use and disclosure of my personal information for the purposes concerned. Please stop these activities and tell me in writing what the withdrawal means for me, as required by Principle 4.3.8.
text.fr: Je retire par la présente mon consentement à la collecte, à l'utilisation et à la communication de mes renseignements personnels pour les fins concernées. Veuillez cesser ces activités et m'informer par écrit des conséquences de ce retrait, conformément au principe 4.3.8.

sources.title: OPC: Responding to access to information requests under PIPEDA
Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada

notes: PIPEDA gives no statutory right to erasure or portability, so those are intentionally omitted. A federal Bill C-36 (Protecting Privacy and Consumer Data Act, tabled 15 June 2026, would add deletion and data-mobility rights) was reported as tabled only and is not in force; it was not checked on parl.ca. Clauses 4.9, 4.9.5 and 4.3.8 and the 30-day rule were verified (Schedule 1 text; OPC page), but the section numbers s. 8(3)-(4) were not opened on the Justice Laws page, hence needs-review. PIPEDA covers federal works and private-sector commercial activity in provinces without a substantially similar law. Quebec (Law 25, Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector) and Alberta and British Columbia (PIPA) apply provincially to most private organizations in those provinces and give their own rights; use those regimes where they apply.
